summary: Verified CSS-variable rename fix for Admin > Mock Interviews modals. Both editor modal (mock-editor-modal) and delete confirmation modal (mock-delete-modal) now render with solid opaque background (rgb(13, 13, 24) resolved from --color-bg-card #0d0d18). Underlying admin table is NOT visible through the modals. All 5 tabs (Firm/Brand/Rounds/Case Study/Raw JSON) in the J.P. Morgan editor are readable and clickable. Cancel/Save Changes buttons and Hide/Hard-delete radios in delete modal work correctly. No regressions observed.

issues: Spec referred to 'Delete permanently' radio, but actual label is 'Hard delete' — minor naming inconsistency, not a bug.

critical_code_review_comments: MockInterviewsTab.jsx uses many hardcoded var(--color-bg-card-hover) / var(--bg-primary) — ensure these vars remain defined in index.css to avoid future silent transparency regressions.
Consider a lint rule / CSS custom-property audit to catch undefined var() references.
context_for_next_testing_agent: CSS var typo fix verified. --color-bg-card resolves to #0d0d18 in dark mode. Both mock-editor-modal (JPM edit) and mock-delete-modal render opaque. All 5 editor tabs functional. No further action required for this bug.
rca of the issue: Bug root cause: bg-[var(--color-card)] referenced an undefined CSS variable, causing transparent modal background. Fix (already applied by main agent): renamed to --color-bg-card (defined in index.css). Verification confirmed computed bg = rgb(13,13,24) matching #0d0d18.
